proposals.evidence: Full lasati explicitly gives its kk-extension Hindi lasaknā to shine and Lahnda lask flashing, tentatively borrowed from Hindi, alongside lahakṇu/lahaknā flare or shine. These support lasak/laskoṇ/laske/lasske/laśk and both laske/laskaṇ alternatives. Use the existing lasakkati extension node; the extension is unnumbered in the prose, so cite the base article. Ordinary local verbal endings and precise transmission remain qualified. Exact response: lasak.
